label: Service Task
description: An automatic step the system carries out without waiting for a person.

handler.label: Handler
handler.description: Which automatic action to perform. If none is chosen, the task waits for a person.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Which resource the handler works on: "created" for what the execution created, if anything, or else the event's target (the default); "target" for the event's target even after a creation.
